test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under PM Gati Shakti, who is responsible for nodal planning?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DPIIT**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM Gati Shakti** is a transformative initiative launched by the Government of India to improve the efficiency of infrastructure projects and reduce the cost and time overruns in their implementation.
 
• The **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)** under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry** is the **nodal agency** responsible for the planning and coordination of this initiative.
 
• **DPIIT** ensures that the planning and implementation of infrastructure projects are carried out in a synchronized manner by integrating various ministries and state governments.
 
• The initiative leverages a digital platform, enabling ministries and departments to coordinate for integrated planning and implementation of infrastructure connectivity projects.
 
• Key objectives include **reducing logistic costs**, improving connectivity, and ensuring sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT):**

 
 
• DPIIT was established in 1995 and is responsible for the overall industrial policy formulation and promotion of industrial growth in India.
 
• It plays a crucial role in facilitating investments and fostering innovation and entrepreneurship in the country.
 
• DPIIT is also responsible for initiatives such as **Make in India**, **Startup India**, and **Ease of Doing Business**.
 
 
 
• **About PM Gati Shakti:**
 
 
• Launched on **13 October 2021**, the **PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan** aims to create a digitally integrated infrastructure network.
 
• The focus is on **multi-modal connectivity**, integrating roads, railways, airways, and waterways to achieve seamless logistics.
 
• The initiative targets sectors such as power transmission, pipelines, industrial corridors, and urban infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Objectives of PM Gati Shakti:**
 
 
• Reducing **infrastructure development time** and associated costs.
 
• Promoting the use of **geospatial planning tools** for project synchronization.
 
• Improving India’s ranking in the **Logistics Performance Index (LPI)**.
 
 
 
• **Role of Other Stakeholders:**
 
 
• While DPIIT is the nodal agency, other ministries like the **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways**, the **Ministry of Railways**, and the **Ministry of Power** play significant roles in project execution.
 
• State governments are also involved in ensuring regional development and inter-state connectivity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of PM Gati Shakti:**

 
 
• It aims to **reduce logistics costs**, which currently account for approximately **13-14% of India’s GDP**.
 
• The plan will help achieve the government’s target of making India a **$5 trillion economy** by 2025.
 
• It also focuses on adopting a **whole-of-government approach** to infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Technology Used:**
 
 
• The initiative leverages **GIS (Geographical Information System)** and **real-time data** for better planning and decision-making.
 
• It integrates data from **29 infrastructure ministries** and various government departments.
